description.value: Clearwater Ski Hill is a volunteer-operated community ski resort that has been running since 1965, featuring a T-bar lift and runs for all abilities. The rustic lodge at the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park doubles as a year-round event venue and summer recreation hub with disc golf and access to local adventures. It is operated by the Clearwater Ski Club with a mandate to keep skiing accessible and affordable for the community.
